title: FRSZ2 for In-Register Block Compression Inside GMRES on GPUs
problem: GMRES iterative solver performance on GPUs is limited by main memory bandwidth. The question is whether sophisticated compression techniques beyond low-precision casting can reduce memory access while preserving solution accuracy.
motivation: Reducing memory bandwidth bottlenecks is critical for accelerating iterative solvers used in large-scale scientific computing applications.
method: FRSZ2 is a lightweight in-register block compressor that decomposes at GPU bandwidth speeds on NVIDIA H100. It compresses the Krylov basis in GMRES with sophisticated techniques that maintain accuracy while reducing memory traffic, replacing simpler low-precision approaches.
key_novelty: FRSZ2 demonstrates that sophisticated compression can outperform low-precision casting for Krylov basis storage while decompressing at full GPU bandwidth.
contributions: FRSZ2, a lightweight in-register block compression technique for GMRES Krylov basis
Experimental validation that sophisticated compression delivers larger runtime benefits than low-precision casting
Demonstration of decompression at NVIDIA H100 bandwidth speeds without accuracy degradation

metrics.speedup: larger runtime benefits vs. low-precision GMRES

primary_theme: GPU memory bandwidth optimization through compression
